adjudication: manual visual comparison against the frozen crop pixels

sample.selection: stratified manual subset covering Arabic, English and bilingual crops, OCR fallbacks, difficult crops, fixed weights, weight-based products, multipacks, bonus packs and count products

statuses.correct: non-null extraction materially matches visible crop evidence
statuses.correct_null: field is not visibly supported and output remains null
statuses.incorrect: visible field was materially misread or contaminated
statuses.hallucinated: non-null extraction is not supported by the visible crop or was taken from price/promotion/purchase-limit text
